name: M. L. McCormack
role: Secretary of Dakota Territory, co-signing the governor's proclamations
bio: M. L. McCormack's name appeared in the Cow Boy only as "Secretary" beneath official territorial notices. He co-signed Governor Gilbert A. Pierce's notice of the Billings County election, printed weekly from February to April 1886. He also co-signed the governor's Thanksgiving proclamation in November 1886.
